rows.note: Use this as the general choice when something is done silently or without being explicitly said.

example.english: They tacitly helped me organize the documents without saying a word.
example.traditional: 佢默默咁幫我執好啲文件，冇出聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mak6 mak6 gam3 bong1 ngo5 zap1 hou2 di1 man4 gin6 mou5 ceot1 seng1

rows.note: Use this when the tacit action specifically means accepting, allowing, or approving something without saying so.

example.english: The manager tacitly allowed me to keep using the room without voicing any objection.
example.traditional: 經理默認咁畀我繼續用間房，完全冇表示反對。
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 mak6 jing6 gam3 bei2 ngo5 gai3 zuk6 jung6 gaan1 fong4 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 biu2 si6 faan2 deoi3

rows.note: Use this when both sides understand the implied meaning or agreement but deliberately do not state it openly.

example.english: We tacitly agreed that we would never talk about this.
example.traditional: 我哋心照不宣咁約定咗，呢件事永遠唔會講出去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sam1 ziu3 bat1 syun1 gam3 joek3 ding6 zo2 ne1 gin6 si6 wing5 jyun5 m4 wui5 gong2 ceot1 heoi3
